title: Preview 0.8 enqueue
statement: Local enqueue works after online sign-in; credentials require refresh every 24 hours.

title: Preview 0.8 restart limitation
statement: Starting the application after more than 24 disconnected hours is not supported in preview 0.8.

title: Preview 0.9 roadmap
statement: Token-independent launch is planned for 0.9; no dated release candidate or completed acceptance evidence is recorded.

title: Export metric scope
statement: Export remains manual; acknowledged-event durability is not covered by the current latency benchmark.
